name: Valuation Dealing Processing Characteristics 3
definition: Valuation dealing processing characteristics linked to the instrument, that is, not to the market.

ValuationFrequencyDescription.name: Valuation Frequency Description
ValuationFrequencyDescription.definition: Further details regarding the dealing frequency, for example, Tuesday (for weekly dealing) or last business day of the month.

DecimalisationUnits.name: Decimalisation Units
DecimalisationUnits.definition: Number of decimal places to which quantities of units/shares are rounded.

DecimalisationPrice.name: Decimalisation Price
DecimalisationPrice.definition: Number of decimal places to which the price is rounded.

DualFundIndicator.name: Dual Fund Indicator
DualFundIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the fund has two prices.

PriceCurrency.name: Price Currency
PriceCurrency.definition: Currencies in which the prices for the investment fund class are published by the fund management company.

AdditionalInformation.name: Additional Information
AdditionalInformation.definition: Additional information about the valuation dealing characteristics.
